items.text: Arizona QB: Gardner Minshew on IR with a torn UCL (season-ending surgery). Rookie Carson Beck started Week 10 and starts again. The schedule still lists Minshew.

Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Arizona: LB Jordan Burch (MCL) out for the season, S Andrew Wingard (wrist/hand) out an extended period, OT Jayden Williams (knee) out. IR - RB James Conner, RB Jeremiyah Love, WR Michael Wilson (season), DT Zachary Carter.

Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Kansas City: RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) missed Week 10 but is expected back. QUESTIONABLE - G Trey Smith (concussion). OUT - TE Jared Wiley (fractured ankle), OT Jaylon Moore, DT Peter Woods. IR - CB L'Jarius Sneed, OT Josh Simmons, WR Tyquan Thornton. Patrick Mahomes starts.
